name: Task Session Navigation
description: Navigation between tasks, sessions and worktrees built on SavedSession.boundTask. Host: command codeWorkbench.tasks.activeSessions lists live task-bound sessions; taskPanelContext (tasksView.ts) pushes them as `activeSessions` in the Tasks panel context (the page is refreshed from extension.ts only when the live bound-session set changes). UI: TasksPanel shows a "▶ <Phase>" chip on tasks with a live session (TaskRow session/onFocusSession) that calls TasksApi.focusSession → codeWorkbench.sessions.focus(id) → SessionManager.open; the page-mode status filter gains "Active session". Sessions view rows gain "Open task" (codeWorkbench.tasks.openTaskInPage) and "Reveal worktree" (codeWorkbench.worktrees.reveal → WorktreesProvider.reveal flashes the row) actions. Live-state churn uses SessionManager.onLiveChange, separate from onDidChange, so it never triggers the structural refresh.
guidelines: The ui package stays host-agnostic: sessions arrive as plain ActiveSession data and focus goes through an optional TasksApi method.
Refresh the Tasks page only when the live bound-session set changes.
anti_patterns: Do not make tasksView depend on SessionManager directly — go through registered commands.
